result.reason: The operative clause meets the fallback and is more protective on notice and cost: audits are limited to once per rolling 12-month period, require 30 days’ notice, occur during business hours, exclude systems access, and remain entirely at HDI’s cost. It does not meet the preferred position because HDI’s General Manager may conduct the inspection instead of requiring an independent auditor. Adding an independent-auditor option also unnecessarily expands the original class of inspectors without achieving the preferred independent-auditor-only requirement. The confidentiality drafting is potentially weak because merely stating that an individual is 'bound' by Section 8 may not create an enforceable obligation absent an undertaking. The margin comment’s offer of twice-yearly audits is outside both playbook positions, although it is not reflected in the operative language.
